senses.gloss: In the position or interval that separates (two things), or intermediate in quantity or degree. (See Usage notes below.)
Denotes a mingling or intermixing with distinct or separable objects. See usage note at amidst.
Of, relating to, or situated in an interstice.
A process or procedure by which tasks are completed. It may be defined by a flowchart with actors, actions, results, decisions, and action paths.
The replaying of something previously recorded, especially sound or moving images.
The study of humanity in its relation to the divine, as in Christian anthropology.
A period of time often defined in the legal system as beginning 30 minutes after sunset, and ending 30 minutes before sunrise.
The hours of darkness between sunset and sunrise; the night.
Something that serves overnight travel, such as a night train.
The grasping of hands by two people when greeting, leave-taking, or making an agreement.
A handle; the portion of a handle that the hand occupies.
The main idea or substance, or the most essential part, of a longer or more complicated matter; the crux, the heart, the pith.
An incorrect use of a term, especially one which is misleading; a misname.
A topical substance formulated to protect the skin from the harmful effects of ultraviolet radiation by absorbing, reflecting or scattering ultraviolet rays.
The point on a line that is midway between the ends.
A centre, midpoint.
The place where decisions for an organization are made; headquarters.
A centre or focus of something.
(seismology) The point on the land or water surface directly above the focus, or hypocentre, of an earthquake.
One who hates or fears strangers or foreigners.
Having two genders simultaneously, most commonly male and female.

To inhale a larger quantity of air than usual, and immediately expel it; to make a deep single audible respiration, especially as the result or involuntary expression of fatigue, exhaustion, grief, sorrow, frustration, or the like.
To invalidate or annul something.
(transitive) To dispel; to rid one’s mind of.
(transitive, legal) To refuse to accept (evidence) as valid.
To abandon or forsake something.
(transitive, legal) To make legally invalid.
(transitive) To rule or determine in a contrary way; to decide against; to abrogate or alter.
To reject as invalid, untrue, or improper.
(intransitive, idiomatic) To distance oneself from an earlier claim or statement; back off from an idea.
at some time in the past
expected to arrive; scheduled
At an earlier or preceding time.
In a direct manner; in a straight line or course.
The Aramaic-derived script used to write the Arabic, Persian, Pashto, Urdu, and Uyghur languages, among others.
One whose occupation is journalism, originally only writing in the printed press.
A retail business selling newspapers, magazines, and stationery; a stationer.
Unwilling to yield or give up; dogged.
Determined to do as one pleases, and not as others want.
Having or revealing little emotion or sensibility.
Characteristic of a mule; stubborn, obstinate, or intractable.
The act of landing in water, as by a space capsule or rollercoaster.
Collectively, the European Union member states whose official currency is the euro.
The act of resuming or starting something again.
Dull; lifeless; lacking originality and vitality.
Causing boredom or tiredness; making one feel tired and impatient.
Boring; not exciting or interesting.
Causing weariness; tiresome.
Boring.
Lacking inspiration; dull or dry
Dull, old-fashioned.
The edge of the land where it meets an ocean, sea, gulf, bay, or large lake.
Land adjoining a non-flowing body of water, such as an ocean, lake or pond.
Coastal land.
Any of various fungi, usually globose, that produce a cloud of brown dust-like spores from their mature fruiting bodies, especially in family Lycoperdaceae.
Not new; previously owned and used by another.
A sedimentary rock produced by the consolidation and compaction of sand, cemented with clay etc.
An atmosphere or aura felt to belong to a person, place or thing.
The features or surroundings of a particular place.
Something that surrounds; encompassing material, substance or shape.
(archaic, except, in plural, formal, also, figuratively) A surrounding area or place (especially of an urban settlement); an environment.
(transitive) To remove or destroy the most important parts of.
(transitive, chiefly, US, colloquial, figuratively) To destroy or erase completely.
(transitive) To pervert, as the mind, and turn it from the truth; to corrupt; to confound.
To ruin many or all things over a large area, such as most or all buildings of a city, or cities of a region, or trees of a forest.
(transitive) To eliminate completely; to annihilate.
(transitive, figurative) To destroy, invalidate, overthrow, or defeat.
To kill or destroy, especially by fire.
A perforated nozzle that showers water on a bather, sometimes in adjustable patterns.
An enzyme used as the first step in making cheese, to curdle the milk and coagulate the casein in it, derived by soaking the fourth stomach of a milk-fed calf in brine.
To disrupt someone's composure or comfort with acting publicly or freely.
Very good; outstanding, wonderful.
piece of land outside with flowers and plants
(baseball, softball) The region of the field between the infield and the outer fence.

A knapsack, sometimes mounted on a light frame, but always supported by straps, worn on a person’s back for the purpose of carrying things, especially when hiking, or on a student's back when carrying books.
A bag or case with one or two shoulder straps, especially used to carry books etc.
(UK, Northeastern US) A bag carried on the back or shoulder, supported by straps.
A case of canvas or leather, for carrying items on the back.
A device for capturing or killing mice and other rodents.
A person whose sexual habits are not considered acceptable.
Turned aside; hence, specifically, turned away from the (morally) right; willfully erring; wicked; perverted
Lecherous.
To surmount (a physical or abstract obstacle); to prevail over, to get the better of.
Of or relating to fascism.
A person or party that is consulted.
One who offers advice.
The act of seceding.
A separation.
An act or incidence of defecting.
Subjugated, beaten, overcome.
A person who loses; one who fails to win or thrive.
A certain number (multiple but not all).
Brief, yet including all important information.
Of speech or writing: brief and to the point; concise.
someone or something that translates meaning from one language to another
A person or thing that interprets the meaning of something for another
A written or printed symbol, or letter.
Each of the sets of a pack of cards distinguished by colour and/or specific emblems, such as the spades, hearts, diamonds, or clubs of traditional Anglo, Hispanic, and French playing cards.
A character or glyph representing an idea, concept or object.
small picture, computer icon
A unique value recognised by a computer program for processing in a special way, or marking the end of a set of data.
A legume plant (Glycine max), commonly cultivated for human and animal consumption and as a nitrogen-fixing ground cover.
One who owns something.
The state of having complete legal control of something; possession; proprietorship.
Agent noun of possess; one who possesses
To attach or fasten (one thing to another) by string or the like.
(intransitive, of an object) To join (to another object): to attach, or to be intended to attach or capable of attaching, to another object.
To tie or fasten tightly together, with a cord, band, ligature, chain, etc.
(transitive) To fasten, to join to (literally and figuratively).
To add something to another thing, especially territory; to incorporate.
(intransitive) To become entangled or caught; to be linked or yoked; to unite; to cling.
(transitive) To bind with a rope, cord, thong, or chain, so as to fasten.
(ambitransitive) To attach or connect in a secure manner.

Any of a specific group of organic compounds essential in small quantities for healthy human growth, metabolism, development, and body function. They are found in minute amounts in plant and animal foods or sometimes produced synthetically, and deficiencies of specific vitamins produce specific disorders.
The act of arriving (reaching a certain place).
A long dowel or plank protruding from the ground; a fencepost; a lightpost.
A solid upright structure designed usually to support a larger structure above it, such as a roof or horizontal beam, but sometimes for decoration.

Any of various data structures designed to hold multiple elements of the same type; especially, a data structure that holds these elements in adjacent memory locations so that they may be retrieved using numeric indices.
A large post, often used as supporting architecture.
plant and its fruit of the genus Cucurbita
Capable of withstanding great physical force.
Which makes resistance or offers opposition.
able to withstand force without cracking; elastic
Firm, unyielding, determined.
The state of being captive.
The state of being enslaved or the practice of slavery.
A system consisting of the parts of an engine through which burned gases or steam are discharged; see also exhaust system.
(clocks, mechanics) The linkage in a (watch) that gives impulses to the timekeeping element and periodically releases the gear train to move forward, advancing the clock's hands.
The simplest alkali metal, the lightest solid element, and the third lightest chemical element (symbol Li) with an atomic number of 3 and atomic weight of 6.94. It is a soft, silvery metal.
Of two or more things: that cannot coexist; not congruous because of differences; unable to function together due to dissimilarities.
Not similar or congruent; not matching or fitting in.
Not in harmony.
Synonym of inharmonious: lacking harmony.
limit of sums
Sensation, particularly through the skin.
The direction in which Muslims face while praying, currently determined as the direction of the Kaaba in Mecca.
The ordinal form of the number twenty.
Showing, causing, or favoring rigour/rigor; scrupulously accurate or strict; thorough.
Carefully attentive to details; studious; diligent in performing a process or procedure.
A similar brown liquid obtained from coal tar used as a wood preservative.
Having been placed in a package.
Any of a group of steroids that are secreted by the ovaries and function as female sex hormones.
(uncountable) A branch of Indo-European languages, which includes the various stages of the Armenian language.
person who has sinned
Having sinned; guilty of sin.
One rejected by God; a sinful person.
Characterized by iniquity (“deviation from what is right”).
The act by which any animal is milked.

A type of pastry that consists of an outer crust and a filling. (Savory pies are more popular in the UK and sweet pies are more popular in the US, so "pie" without qualification has different connotations in these dialects.)

A type of small open pie, or piece of pastry, now typically containing jelly (US) / jam (UK) or conserve, or sometimes other fillings (chocolate, custard, egg, butter, historically even meat or other savory fillings).
Any of a variety of stuffed pastries found in Spanish, Filipino, and Latin American cuisine.
Small pastries filled with finely chopped meat, vegetables or fruit baked or fried, from eastern European cuisine, or a serving of these.
Viscid mucus produced by the body, later especially mucus expelled from the bronchial passages by coughing.
Grime, dirt, slime; any vague, messy, or unknown substance.
Matter coughed up and expectorated from the mouth, composed of saliva and discharges from the respiratory passages such as mucus, phlegm or pus.
The capital city of Saxony, Germany, on the River Elbe. [1735]
The property of being rude.
The state or quality of being irreverent; want of proper reverence; disregard of the authority and character of a superior.
The state or characteristic of being a boor or of being boorish; boorish behaviour.
person devoted to studying philosophy
The ground-up edible part of various grains, used as a basis of food or feed; either flour or a coarser blend than flour (usage varies).
Small, hard, inedible particles in food.
Coarse grains produced at an intermediate stage of wheat flour milling.
One who supplies; a provider.
A wild, headlong running away or scamper of a number of animals, usually caused by fright.
Ruin; defeat, (also) that which causes defeat or ruin.
(logic, computing) Pertaining to data items that can have “true” and “false” (or, equivalently, 1 and 0 respectively) as their only possible values and to operations on such values.
The main language of the Netherlands, Flanders (i.e., the northern half of Belgium) and Suriname; Netherlandic.
A Dutch woman; a woman from the Netherlands.
(astronomy, moons) The outermost major moon of Uranus.
Not experiencing sexual attraction; lacking interest in or desire for sex.

A game, often played by children, in which a player leaps like a frog over the back of another person who has stooped over. One variation of the game involves a number of people lining up in a row and bending over. The last person in the line then vaults forward over each of the others until they reach the front of the line, whereupon they also bend over. The process is then repeated.

The cavity of the belly, which is lined by the peritoneum, and contains the viscera; often restricted in humans to the part between the diaphragm and the commencement of the pelvis, the remainder being called the pelvic cavity.
Pertaining to a gland or glands.
One who usurps.
A missionary, or leader of a religious mission, especially one in the early Christian Church (but see Apostle).
A mammal of the order Rodentia, characterized by long incisors that grow continuously and are worn down by gnawing.
Text carved on a wall or plaque, such as a memorial or gravestone, or on some other item.
A sacred act and the attendant ceremony, considered (theology) an outward sign of divine grace, instituted by Jesus Christ.
The annual herb Coriandrum sativum, used in many cuisines.
To hit with a whip.
(transitive) To whip or scourge as punishment.
(transitive) To whip or scourge.
To utter a sudden and loud cry, as in joy, triumph, exultation or anger, or to attract attention, to animate others, etc.
The simplest aliphatic alcohol, CH₃OH; a colourless, toxic, inflammable liquid, used as a solvent, antifreeze, in the chemical industry, and in the preparation of methylated spirit.
A wood-based material resembling heavy paper, used in the manufacture of boxes, cartons and signs.
A professional who counsels people, especially on personal problems.
The attempt to profit by manipulating the economic or political environment, for example, by seeking governmental action that restricts entry into a market.
To sway or tilt violently back and forth.
(intransitive) To burn or shine unsteadily, or with a wavering light.
(intransitive) To move with an uneven or rocking motion, or unsteadily to and fro.
To waver or be unsteady; to weaken or trail off.
Wastefully extravagant.
Improvident, profligate, or wasteful.

Complex, detailed, or sophisticated.
The grasping of hands by two people when greeting, leave-taking, or making an agreement.
Powder used in laser printers and photocopiers to form the text and images on the printed paper.
A valued possession that has been passed down through the generations.
A keepsake; an object kept as a reminder of a place or event.
Works of art created by sculpting, as a group.
Resembling or shaped like a star.

(music) Chiefly in rock and heavy metal: to play (a musical instrument (especially a guitar) or a piece of music) very fast and in a way that requires technical skill.
To tear apart by force; to rend; to split; to cleave.
(transitive) To separate into parts with force or sudden violence; to split; to burst.
machine
(especially, nautical) A vertical cylindrical machine that revolves on a spindle, typically surmounted by a drumhead with sockets for levers for turning it; used to apply force to cables, ropes, etc.
black bindweed (Fallopia convolvulus).
That has been described as greater than it actually is; abnormally increased or enlarged.
